description: The place, scene, or point of something where someone or something has been, is, and/or will be at a given moment in time. It can be defined with one or more position points (coordinates) in a given coordinate system.
title: Location

MaintenanceLocation.nearestIntersection.title: nearestIntersection
MaintenanceLocation.nearestIntersection.description: The names of streets at the nearest intersection to work area.

InternalLocation.buildingName.title: buildingName
InternalLocation.buildingName.description: Name of building where location is.

MaintenanceLocation.subdivision.title: subdivision
MaintenanceLocation.subdivision.description: (if applicable) Name, identifier, or description of the subdivision in which work is to occur.

Ravens.cimObjectType.title: cimObjectType
Ravens.cimObjectType.description: Used in RAVENS Schema to identify the corresponding CIM Object Type of the JSON object.

IdentifiedObject.description.title: description
IdentifiedObject.description.description: The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

UsagePointLocation.accessMethod.title: accessMethod
UsagePointLocation.accessMethod.description: Method for the service person to access this usage point location. For example, a description of where to obtain a key if the facility is unmanned and secured.

UsagePointLocation.siteAccessProblem.title: siteAccessProblem
UsagePointLocation.siteAccessProblem.description: Problems previously encountered when visiting or performing work at this location. Examples include: bad dog, violent customer, verbally abusive occupant, obstructions, safety hazards, etc.

ProposedSiteLocation.availableArea.title: availableArea
ProposedSiteLocation.availableArea.description: Land area available for PV and/or Wind development

InternalLocation.buildingNumber.title: buildingNumber
InternalLocation.buildingNumber.description: Number of building where location is.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName.title: aliasName
IdentifiedObject.aliasName.description:
The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

Location.type.title: type
Location.type.description: Classification by utility's corporate standards and practices, relative to the location itself (e.g., geographical, functional accounting, etc., not a given property that happens to exist at that location).

Location.secondaryAddress.title: secondaryAddress
Location.secondaryAddress.description: Secondary address of the location. For example, PO Box address may have different ZIP code than that in the 'mainAddress'.

ServiceLocation.siteAccessProblem.title: siteAccessProblem
ServiceLocation.siteAccessProblem.description: Problems previously encountered when visiting or performing work on this location. Examples include: bad dog, violent customer, verbally abusive occupant, obstructions, safety hazards, etc.

IdentifiedObject.mRID.title: mRID
IdentifiedObject.mRID.description:
Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

MaintenanceLocation.lot.title: lot
MaintenanceLocation.lot.description: (if applicable) Name, identifier, or description of the lot in which work is to occur.

ServiceLocation.needsInspection.title: needsInspection
ServiceLocation.needsInspection.description: True if inspection is needed of facilities at this service location. This could be requested by a customer, due to suspected tampering, environmental concerns (e.g., a fire in the vicinity), or to correct incompatible data.

Location.direction.title: direction
Location.direction.description: (if applicable) Direction that allows field crews to quickly find a given asset. For a given location, such as a street address, this is the relative direction in which to find the asset. For example, a streetlight may be located at the 'NW' (northwest) corner of the customer's site, or a usage point may be located on the second floor of an apartment building.

Location.geoInfoReference.title: geoInfoReference
Location.geoInfoReference.description: (if applicable) Reference to geographical information source, often external to the utility.

MaintenanceLocation.block.title: block
MaintenanceLocation.block.description: (if applicable) Name, identifier, or description of the block in which work is to occur.

ServiceLocation.accessMethod.title: accessMethod
ServiceLocation.accessMethod.description: Method for the service person to access this service location. For example, a description of where to obtain a key if the facility is unmanned and secured.

IdentifiedObject.name.title: name
IdentifiedObject.name.description: The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.
